conceptZh: 雲是天上飄著的白色棉花團
object: a chunky toy fire engine with its crew and a fluffy cotton cloud
morph: a domino chain of foam pieces tumbles and lands as 雲
creativeAngle: 消防小隊撞倒第一塊骨牌，連鎖倒成字，水管噴出雲朵。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 雲 (cloud). Lead: a red toy fire engine with a bendy yellow hose that whips around on its own. Moment 1 (0-1.7s): the engine rolls in and gently bumps the first blue domino; the voice says 雲 as the domino wobbles. Moment 2 (1.7-3.4s): the chain tumbles across the stage, the hose squirting in the wrong direction and bending a few; the second 雲 lands as the last piece clicks, forming 雲. Moment 3 (3.4-5.3s): the hose finally puffs a soft white fluffy cloud from the nozzle; as the voice says 雲朵 the cloud grows, floats up, and the firefighter pup toy rides it. Moment 4 (5.3-8s): glyph still; the cloud drifts and drops a tiny harmless sparkle on the engine. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "雲、雲、雲朵" (ㄩㄣˊ、ㄩㄣˊ、ㄩㄣˊ ㄉㄨㄛˇ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 雲, drawn as saturated solid sky blue strokes on a very pale warm gray background, correctly formed, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins, perfectly still for the final 3-second hold while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.

conceptZh: 豬探長把一大團蓬蓬的白雲當成線索，先衝過去撲空摔了個狗吃屎，再退得更遠全速撞上去「碰」一聲，雲被壓扁成雨字頭、震出四滴小雨點，底下的雲團捲成云，變成雲字，豬探長被壓成薄餅暈頭轉向地笑。
object: a giant fluffy white cloud squatting on the ground like a puffy marshmallow boulder, the "clue" that Detective Pig charges at
morph: the crash flattens the cloud's top into the 雨 rain-head (a flat roof line, a short vertical under it, a box with a center vertical) and shakes four raindrops loose that hang as the four dots; the cloud's lower puff coils into 云 (two short flat bars above a small curling hook)
creativeAngle: 上一版是消防車推骨牌、雲只是點綴；這版把雲本身變成被撞的「牆」：豬探長第一次撲空（雲飄起來）、第二次退更遠全速撞上，撞擊本身把雲壓成雨字頭、震出四滴雨點，下方雲團捲成云，字形直接由撞擊產生，動作、笑點與字義完全同一件事。不需要第二個角色，畫面只有豬探長和雲。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 雲 (cloud). Bright flat stage, very pale cream background, nothing busy behind. Lead: Detective Pig, a stout cartoon pig in a checked deerstalker hat, carrying a magnifying glass far too big for him, who sprints at every clue at full speed.

Moment 1 (0–1.5s): Detective Pig stands at the far left. At the far right squats a giant fluffy white cloud, round and puffy as a marshmallow boulder, resting on the ground. He squints through the huge magnifying glass, gasps "a clue!", digs all four hooves in, and leans way back in a stretched wind-up. The voice says the first 雲 as he leans back.

Moment 2 (1.5–3s): He rockets across the frame, little legs blurring. Just as he arrives, the cloud bobs lazily upward one puff. He shoots straight underneath, skids on his belly, and tumbles into a heap, hat spinning on one ear. He pops up, plants the hat firmly, and backs up even farther left, snorting.

Moment 3 (3–4.5s): A frozen beat of anticipation, then he charges twice as fast, magnifying glass held out like a battering ram. The cloud drifts back down and BONK: squash-and-stretch impact. The cloud's top squashes flat and hardens into solid deep cobalt-blue strokes forming the 雨 rain-head: a flat roof line on top, a short vertical under it, then a wide box with a center vertical. Four fat raindrops shaken loose bounce once and hang inside the box as the four dots, two on each side. The cloud's lower puff coils under it into 云: two short flat bars stacked above a small curling hook with a tiny dot at its end. The voice says the second 雲 exactly as the last raindrop clicks into place. The finished 雲 is centered, correct, filling about 70% of frame height with margins.

Moment 4 (4.5–8s): The glyph holds perfectly still and readable. Detective Pig peels off the strokes flattened like a pancake, wobbles sideways at the bottom-left corner, and gives a dizzy, delighted grin. He reinflates with a soft pop. As the voice says 雲朵, a small fluffy white cloud puffs out of his magnifying glass lens and floats above his hat; he hops once with joy and tips his hat to it, never touching the strokes.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "雲、雲、雲朵" (ㄩㄣˊ、ㄩㄣˊ、ㄩㄣˊ ㄉㄨㄛˇ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, one short pause between each, then stops. No other speech, no music louder than the voice. Soft cartoon bonk and boing sounds only.

The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 雲, correctly formed, solid saturated cobalt blue on the pale cream background. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans. Bright but not neon, no dark grading.
